Style Transfer (ST) is the task of automatically transforming text in one style into another ... we benchmark several methods and perform automatic and human evaluations on their outputs.
This work takes the first step towards a more language-inclusive direction for the field of ST by building the first corpus of style transfer for non-English languages.
